evals.name: hstack-to-arrangement
evals.expected_output: A Swift file that compiles against the iOS 27.1 SDK at an iOS 26 deployment target, uses ArrangementView behind #available(iOS 27.1, *) with size preferences on BOTH panes (not on the container), keeps navigation outside the arrangement, and keeps a working fallback for older OS versions and narrow/tall containers.

evals.name: toolbar-vertical-bar
evals.expected_output: A Swift file that compiles against the iOS 27.1 SDK at an iOS 26 deployment target; gives items both a title and a symbol; keeps Compose visible with visibilityPriority; moves the custom menu into ToolbarOverflowMenu; keeps the Select/Done text item horizontal with axisBehavior(.horizontalOnly); all new API gated by availability.

evals.name: audit-report
evals.expected_output: A prioritised Markdown report that identifies: UIScreen.main (two screens), idiom-based layout (inner display is regular width on a phone), hard-coded 47 inset fallback, symmetric inset arithmetic (asymmetric insets with a vertical bar), connectedScenes.first (multiple scenes), hero height as 60% of a short screen, stretched search field, idiom-driven grid columns, fixed camera selection / fold is not a scenePhase change, and the uncatchable flash-mode crash — each with the reason and the replacement.
